wahaControlQr.title: Pair Hospital and Doctor WhatsApp QR Code - Official Gateway
wahaControlQr.subtitle: Scan this QR code from the official Hospital or Doctor WhatsApp account to link the gateway, enabling automated patient follow-up reminders and booking notifications.
wahaControlQr.step1Desc: Open WhatsApp on the official Hospital or DPJP Doctor mobile device.
wahaControlQr.step2Desc: Open the Linked Devices menu and select Link a Device.
wahaControlQr.step3Desc: Point your camera at the QR code below to connect the gateway session.
wahaControlQr.step4Desc: Once connected, the gateway actively dispatches automated patient follow-up control reminders on D-3, D-1, and day of visit.
